match.definition: MATCH_m=1 iff each of the three observed components equals the corresponding canonical core component
match.partial_matches: reported component-by-component, not counted as exact

B0_MEASUREMENT_INVALID_OR_INCONCLUSIVE.when: any required primary measurement is technically invalid or scientifically undefined

B1_BROAD_EXTERNAL_PANEL_STABILITY.claim_ceiling: The registered structural compatibility profiles were stable on the prospectively constructed three-class external panel in all three tested models.

B2_MOSTLY_STABLE_WITH_MODEL_SPECIFIC_CHA.claim_ceiling: External-panel stability held for two of the three tested models, with one model exhibiting a profile change.

B3_LIMITED_EXTERNAL_PANEL_STABILITY.claim_ceiling: Only limited model-level external-panel stability was observed.

B4_BROAD_EXTERNAL_PANEL_PROFILE_CHANGE.claim_ceiling: All three tested models changed structural profile on the external panel, indicating substantial panel/task conditionality of the registered profile summaries.

secondary_diagnostics.interpretation: Task-stratified diagnostics localize which semantic classes contributed to the aggregate external-panel result.

technical_vs_scientific_failure.DATASET_VALIDATION_FAILURE: shape, semantic, leakage, pairing, split, or hash validation fails
technical_vs_scientific_failure.MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: required metric cannot be validly computed
technical_vs_scientific_failure.SCIENTIFIC_NONREPLICATION: valid measurement exists but one or more model profiles do not match

hard_stop.next_phase: Paper-A final manuscript phase; technical recovery only without scientific semantic change
